The '''''Lady of Bestine''''' was a spacious passenger [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Del Rey]] [[Wookieepedia:The Star Wars Legends Novels Timeline|''Star Wars'' Legends Novels Timeline]] places ''Kenobi'' between the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] and ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', both of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Annileen Calwell]] left [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] on the ''Lady of Bestine'' with her two children, [[Kallie Calwell|Kallie]] and [[Jabe Calwell|Jabe]], after her college application was accepted by the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]].<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
